infographics.title: Google reCAPTCHA Integration - Architecture Overview
infographics.svgContent:
```xml
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1400 900" width="100%">
    <title>Google reCAPTCHA Integration Architecture</title>
    <desc>
        An SVG infographic showing the architecture and component relationships for Google reCAPTCHA integration. 
        It illustrates the flow from the Frontend Application, through Backend API Gateway, Auth Service, 
        reCAPTCHA Verification Service, to the external Google reCAPTCHA API and a Database.
    </desc>

    <defs>
        <marker id="arrowhead" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" 
                refX="0" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
            <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" fill="#343A40" />
        </marker>
    </defs>

    <style>
        .title { font-family: 'Arial, sans-serif'; font-size: 36px; font-weight: bold; fill: #343A40; }
        .component-name { font-family: 'Arial, sans-serif'; font-size: 20px; font-weight: bold; fill: #343A40; text-anchor: middle; }
        .component-desc { font-family: 'Arial, sans-serif'; font-size: 14px; fill: #343A40; text-anchor: middle; }
        .label { font-family: 'Arial, sans-serif'; font-size: 14px; fill: #343A40; }
        .arrow { stroke: #343A40; stroke-width: 2; fill: none; marker-end: url(#arrowhead); }

        /* Component Colors */
        .frontend { fill: #007BFF; stroke: #0056b3; } /* Blue */
        .service { fill: #FFC107; stroke: #d39e00; } /* Yellow/Orange */
        .external { fill: #28A745; stroke: #1e7e34; } /* Green */
        .database { fill: #6C757D; stroke: #545b62; } /* Grey */
    </style>

    <!-- Title -->
    <text x="700" y="60" class="title" text-anchor="middle">Google reCAPTCHA Integration Architecture</text>

    <!-- Components -->
    <!-- Frontend Application -->
    <rect x="100" y="150" width="200" height="120" rx="10" ry="10" class="frontend" />
    <text x="200" y="185" class="component-name">Frontend Application</text>
    <text x="200" y="215" class="component-desc">
        <tspan x="200" dy="0">User Interface,</tspan>
        <tspan x="200" dy="18">Displays reCAPTCHA widget,</tspan>
        <tspan x="200" dy="18">Submits reCAPTCHA token</tspan>
    </text>

    <!-- Backend API Gateway -->
    <rect x="400" y="150" width="200" height="120" rx="10" ry="10" class="service" />
    <text x="500" y="185" class="component-name">Backend API Gateway</text>
    <text x="500" y="215" class="component-desc">
        <tspan x="500" dy="0">Entry Point for Backend,</tspan>
        <tspan x="500" dy="18">Routes requests</tspan>
    </text>

    <!-- Auth Service -->
    <rect x="400" y="350" width="200" height="140" rx="10" ry="10" class="service" />
    <text x="500" y="385" class="component-name">Auth Service</text>
    <text x="500" y="415" class="component-desc">
        <tspan x="500" dy="0">Handles User Auth/Reg,</tspan>
        <tspan x="500" dy="18">Orchestrates reCAPTCHA,</tspan>
        <tspan x="500" dy="18">Interacts with DB</tspan>
    </text>

    <!-- reCAPTCHA Verification Service -->
    <rect x="400" y="550" width="200" height="120" rx="10" ry="10" class="service" />
    <text x="500" y="585" class="component-name">reCAPTCHA Verification Service</text>
    <text x="500" y="615" class="component-desc">
        <tspan x="500" dy="0">Dedicated Microservice,</tspan>
        <tspan x="500" dy="18">Calls Google reCAPTCHA API,</tspan>
        <tspan x="500" dy="18">Manages API keys</tspan>
    </text>

    <!-- Google reCAPTCHA API (External) -->
    <rect x="750" y="550" width="200" height="100" rx="10" ry="10" class="external" />
    <text x="850" y="585" class="component-name">Google reCAPTCHA API</text>
    <text x="850" y="615" class="component-desc">
        <tspan x="850" dy="0">External Service,</tspan>
        <tspan x="850" dy="18">Verifies reCAPTCHA token</tspan>
    </text>

    <!-- Database -->
    <rect x="750" y="350" width="200" height="100" rx="10" ry="10" class="database" />
    <text x="850" y="385" class="component-name">Database</text>
    <text x="850" y="415" class="component-desc">
        <tspan x="850" dy="0">Stores User Data,</tspan>
        <tspan x="850" dy="18">Auth Credentials</tspan>
    </text>

    <!-- Interactions -->
    <!-- 1. Frontend to API Gateway (Submit data with token) -->
    <path d="M300 210 H400" class="arrow" />
    <text x="350" y="200" class="label" text-anchor="middle">1. POST /login {..., token}</text>

    <!-- 2. API Gateway to Auth Service (Forward request) -->
    <path d="M500 270 V350" class="arrow" />
    <text x="505" y="310" class="label">2. Forward Request</text>

    <!-- 3. Auth Service to reCAPTCHA Verification Service (Call verification) -->
    <path d="M500 490 V550" class="arrow" />
    <text x="505" y="520" class="label">3. Call: verifyRecaptcha(token)</text>

    <!-- 4. reCAPTCHA Verification Service to Google reCAPTCHA API (Verify token) -->
    <path d="M600 600 H750" class="arrow" />
    <text x="675" y="590" class="label" text-anchor="middle">4. POST /siteverify</text>

    <!-- 5. Google reCAPTCHA API to reCAPTCHA Verification Service (Return result) -->
    <path d="M750 620 H600" class="arrow" />
    <text x="675" y="640" class="label" text-anchor="middle">5. Response: {success: true/false}</text>

    <!-- 6. reCAPTCHA Verification Service to Auth Service (Return verification result) -->
    <path d="M500 670 V490" class="arrow" />
    <text x="505" y="520" class="label" dy="150">6. Return: verificationResult</text>

    <!-- 7. Auth Service to Database (Query credentials) -->
    <path d="M600 400 H750" class="arrow" />
    <text x="675" y="390" class="label" text-anchor="middle">7. Query: validateCredentials</text>

    <!-- 8. Database to Auth Service (Return user record) -->
    <path d="M750 420 H600" class="arrow" />
    <text x="675" y="440" class="label" text-anchor="middle">8. Return: userRecord</text>

    <!-- 9. Auth Service to API Gateway (Return auth result) -->
    <path d="M500 350 V270" class="arrow" />
    <text x="505" y="310" class="label" dy="-150">9. Return: authResult</text>

    <!-- 10. API Gateway to Frontend (Return final response) -->
    <path d="M400 230 H300" class="arrow" />
    <text x="350" y="240" class="label" text-anchor="middle">10. Response: {status, token}</text>

</svg>
```
